title: What she calls him
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Tuesday. The owner has never called him anything. Today she reads the digest's margin and says 'Wood, then.' He says either. She says Finch, and that's what she uses from here. The strip notices she has a first name for him and isn't spending it.

panels.composition: The shop. The OWNER at the counter with a digest — one of his, left on the counter. Reading the margin. WOOD at the cutter.

panels.composition: The shop. The mat cutter going. She has a first name for him and isn't spending it. The strip knows from the HELP WANTED card she read his whole name off the form. It waits.
